scope: Tool Calibration and Route Switch 2D overlay Image2-source-backed layers
sourcePolicy: Primary art is backed by Image2/source PNGs saved under src/assets/gui/*/image2-sources. Local scripts only crop, resize, compose dark backing plates, compress PNGs, and write regions JSON.
stylePrompt: Human Protocol premium facility console: black anodized metal, aged brass, smoked glass, cyan glow, cyan glass tubes, energy cores, edge lights, and restrained amber accents. No hands, no skin tones, no biological forms, no gore.

image2Sources.role: Complete no-hand Tool Calibration Image2 UI source. Used for left tool bay crop and no-text tile crops.
image2Sources.notes: Source contains live-style mock text in the full image; derived runtime layers avoid using text areas.

image2Sources.role: Clean black-gold/cyan hardware modules source. Used for the horizontal clean calibration rod and module cuts.
image2Sources.notes: No hands, no skin tones, no biological forms, no text.

image2Sources.role: Saved Level07 route-switch Image2 parts source. Used for output/button layer composition.
image2Sources.notes: No baked gameplay text; matches existing route-switch Image2 regions contract.

image2Sources.role: Source-backed route output bay assembly used to build complete cyan/amber/green/violet output bay atlas.
image2Sources.notes: Pixels are assembled from saved Image2 route-switch parts; no gameplay text, logo, or local-drawn main visual.

deliverables.recommendedUse: Primary left-side tool bay image. Clean horizontal experimental calibration rod/canister with no hands or skin tones.
Alternate left tool bay crop from the complete UI source.
Source-backed no-text tile/module atlas with cyan lit cells, blocked sockets, glass module, and energy core.
Route Switch output/display/button layer for a complete overlay composition. Keep labels and state text in React/CSS.
Runtime Route Switch output bay sprites: output_bay_cyan, output_bay_amber, output_bay_green, output_bay_violet, and output_bay_off.

scripts.role: Cuts the clean horizontal calibration rod and module sheet from saved Image2 hardware source.
Cuts source-backed left tool bay, no-text tile/module atlas, and route output/button layer from saved Image2 sources.
